# Anaysis for outputs required by PMDA in oncology

`{anaume}` is a package to generate outputs required in oncology therapeutic area by PMDA.

```{r}
library(anaume)
```

# Setup for dummy data

Dummy data were based on `pharmaverseadam`.

```{r}
adae <- pharmaverseadam::adae
adsl <- pharmaverseadam::adsl
```
